# indentation

Require configured indentation for Feature, Background, Rule, Scenario, step, Examples, and tag lines; content inside a Rule is checked when `rule content` sets its extra indentation.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| formatting | no | yes | none |

Reports and safely fixes indentation. Defaults: `Feature`, `Background`, `Rule`, `Scenario`, `Examples` 0, `Step` and `example` 2; `given`, `when`, `then`, `and`, `but`, `feature tag`, and `scenario tag` override per line type. Content inside a Rule is checked only when `rule content` sets its extra indentation.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "indentation": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
   Scenario: shifted
```
